title: Federal Lawsuit: Union sues New York City to block carriage ban; owners seek compensation
summary_full: In a groundbreaking move, New York City has decided to phase out the horse-drawn carriage industry by June 2028, prompted by safety concerns highlighted by the tragic case of Romanch, a tourist fatally injured in an accident. The Transport Workers Union of America has responded with a lawsuit, claiming the new legislation jeopardizes their livelihoods.
